{{Otheruses|Cron}}
A '''Cronese battlebird''' (or '''Cronian battlebird''') was a warship, presumably built by the [[Kingdom of Cron]], during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. They originally fought under [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ferece]] against Xer of [[Argai]], then for him as their king, [[Xer VIII]] in the [[Cronese Sweeps]]. They would later serve Xer's son [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]] in the [[Xim Wars]].
